Name: Green Ooze
Description: Sticky green goo from Green Slimes. Alchemists love it.

Name: Stone
Description: Good, solid stone from the old farm walls. Builders need it.

Name: Animal Hair
Description: Soft hair from Bunny Warriors. The Tailor sews with it.

Name: Hops
Description: Green hop flowers. The Innkeeper brews ale with them.

Name: Hay
Description: Dry golden straw from the Abandoned Farm. Good for bedding, roofs and animal feed.

Name: Grain
Description: Wheat from the old farm fields. The Inn could bake with it.

Name: Wool
Description: Soft wool from the sheep that never left the farm. The Tailor will want it.

Name: Golden Fleece
Description: Shining golden wool. Very rare: only a lucky scavenge finds it.

Name: Sticks
Description: Dry sticks from the old farm. Craft them into torches at the Guild Hall's crafting bench.

Name: Torch
Description: A torch you crafted (1 Sticks + 1 Wool). Take it out exploring to light up dark places, like the farm's Dark Cellars.

Name: Mysterious Orb
Description: Found in the medallion chest in the Guild Hall. It's cool to the touch, and every now and then... it hums.
